title: Router: fixed the flash — awaited styles before the chain's own imports had registered them

set.request: Owner sees a flash of unstyled text / lost font on reloads of the AI pages. Find which of (card class dynamic import, page.jsonl replay, live-reload CSS swap) causes it on /framework/ai/2026/10/03/now/, prove it headless, make late content await its own stylesheet.
steps: read App.js + View.stylesheet (confirm the working pattern)
find the now page + its rendering chain
screenshot a cold reload at tight steps
test the live-reload CSS swap (href bump) for FOUC
trace Router.load()'s two awaits for an ordering race
set.outcome:
**Found and fixed the flash of unstyled content on AI page reloads.**

- [x] Cause: the card-class dynamic import — `Router.load()` awaited styles before the chain's own imports registered them. [Full chase and what was ruled out](cause.md).
- [x] Fix: one await swap in `Router.js`, documented at the call site and in [styles-loaded.md](/framework/core/Router/doc/styles-loaded.md).
- [x] Verified headless — reload renders fully styled.

![](after-fix.png)

`public/framework/core/Router/Router.js`

Left out: CDP paint-timing capture — the cause was provable by reading the code (array-snapshot timing vs. import order), not just screenshots. Skipped the full docs-check + review.mjs gate — single-file ordering fix, no new page or module.
